_comment: Numerical checkpoints for the two shipped Caneda sample projects. RC values are the closed-form response to a finite 1 us ramp (tau = R*C = 1 kohm * 1 uF = 1 ms), not simulator snapshots, so the check is independent of ngspice. Rectifier values are ngspice-47 results; its closed form needs the diode's exponential model.

rc-lowpass.description: RC low-pass step response. V1 steps 0 -> 5 V at 1 ms with a 1 us rise, R1 = 1 kohm, C1 = 1 uF, so tau = 1 ms. The settling sleeve is fully captured inside the 7 ms run.

diode-rectifier.description: Half-wave rectifier with smoothing. V1 is a 50 Hz, 10 V peak sine, D1 is the default Caneda diode, and the load is R1 = 1 kohm in parallel with C1 = 470 uF. The output settles to roughly 8.9-9.25 V with about 0.36 V peak-to-peak ripple, i.e. one diode drop below the 10 V peak.
